hero.headline: Full-Service Catering for Every Occasion
hero.subheading: From intimate gatherings to grand celebrations, SWAAD delivers authentic flavours, flawless presentation, and professional service tailored to your event.

eventTypes.headline: Every Celebration, Perfectly Catered
eventTypes.intro: We bring the same passion and precision to every event type — whether you are planning a grand wedding, a corporate luncheon, or a private family gathering.

events.title: Weddings
events.description: Your wedding day deserves nothing short of extraordinary. We craft bespoke wedding menus that honour your heritage, delight your guests, and create memories that last a lifetime. From the welcome drinks to the grand dessert spread, every detail is handled with care.

events.title: Corporate Events
events.description: Impress clients, reward your team, and elevate your corporate events with SWAAD's professional catering. We handle everything from boardroom lunches and product launches to large-scale annual conferences — always on time, always exceptional.

events.title: Birthdays & Anniversaries
events.description: Make every milestone unforgettable with a feast crafted around the guest of honour. Whether it is a milestone birthday, a silver anniversary, or a surprise party, we design menus that reflect the personality and preferences of the person being celebrated.

events.title: Private & Family Gatherings
events.description: Some of the most meaningful celebrations happen at home. Our private catering service brings restaurant-quality food and professional service to your home, garden, or private venue — so you can be fully present with your loved ones.

events.title: Festivals & Cultural Events
events.description: Celebrate Diwali, Navratri, Eid, Christmas, and every cultural occasion with authentic food that honours tradition. Our festival menus are crafted to reflect the spirit of each celebration, with dishes that bring communities together.

events.title: Outdoor & Destination Events
events.description: From garden parties and rooftop celebrations to destination events and outdoor weddings, SWAAD's mobile catering team brings the full kitchen experience to any location. We handle all logistics so you can focus on the celebration.

experiences.headline: Beyond the Buffet
experiences.intro: Elevate your event with immersive food experiences that entertain and delight your guests.

items.title: Live Cooking Stations
items.description: Our live stations transform dining into theatre. Guests watch skilled chefs prepare dishes to order — from fresh dosas and pani puri to stir-fries and pasta. Interactive, engaging, and utterly delicious.

items.title: BBQ & Tandoor
items.description: Our traditional clay tandoor and charcoal BBQ setup is a showstopper at any event. Guests gather around the grill as our chefs produce perfectly charred kebabs, tikkas, and naans fresh from the fire.

items.title: Grand Buffet Service
items.description: Our signature buffet service combines abundance with elegance. Beautifully presented spreads of Indian and Chinese dishes, thoughtfully arranged and continuously replenished by our attentive service team.

items.title: Tiffin Service
items.description: Enjoy fresh, homemade-style meals delivered straight to your door with Swaad Catering’s Tiffin Services. Perfect for students, professionals, and families, our daily meals are prepared with fresh ingredients, authentic flavours, and the comfort of ghar ka swaad.

indian.title: Authentic Indian Cuisine
indian.description: From the rich gravies of North India to the aromatic rice dishes of the South, our Indian menu spans the full breadth of the subcontinent's culinary heritage. Every dish is prepared using traditional techniques and the finest whole spices.

chinese.title: Hakka Chinese Cuisine
chinese.description: Bold, spiced, and deeply satisfying — our Hakka Chinese menu brings the beloved Indo-Chinese flavours that have become a staple of Indian celebrations. Wok-tossed noodles, crispy manchurian, and fiery schezwan dishes prepared fresh.

corporate.headline: Catering That Works as Hard as You Do
corporate.body: We understand that corporate events demand reliability, professionalism, and flexibility. SWAAD offers dedicated corporate catering packages designed for businesses of all sizes — from daily office lunches to large-scale annual events. Our team coordinates directly with your event manager to ensure seamless execution every time.

features.title: Recurring Office Catering
features.desc: Weekly or monthly catering packages for team lunches, town halls, and office celebrations.

features.title: Conference & Seminar Catering
features.desc: Full-day catering packages with breakfast, lunch, tea breaks, and evening receptions.

features.title: Product Launch Events
features.desc: Impressive food presentations that complement your brand and impress your guests.

features.title: Client Entertainment
features.desc: Premium dining experiences for client meetings, board dinners, and hospitality events.

cta.headline: Let's Plan Your Event Together
cta.subheading: Tell us about your event and we'll craft a bespoke catering proposal within 24 hours.
